title: Dual climate control and display expectations
summary: Feedback centers on missing or downgraded dual-zone climate control, confusing display cues, and some irritation with how climate functions are presented or operated.

positive.summary: The only positive example says the climate system is otherwise fine but still wishes dual climate control were standard.

negative.summary: Negative reviews complain about missing standard dual climate control, lack of rear climate controls, annoying display-based controls, and general dissatisfaction with the climate setup.

mixed.summary: Mixed reviews pair broader vehicle approval with disappointment that dual or independent climate control features expected at this level are missing or downgraded.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined excerpts mention misleading dual-zone cues in the display or manuals, one clearly favorable climate comment, and a too-brief note about displays that lacks enough context for firm sentiment classification.

limitations: Several excerpts are very short or lack surrounding context, which limits confidence about the reviewer’s exact stance on the climate system.
The topic mixes concrete hardware complaints about dual-zone or rear climate functionality with interface or display-perception comments, so the cluster is not fully uniform.
Samples are stratified and not representative, so these excerpts should not be treated as estimates of overall owner experience.
